defensive_tilt.rationale: A crowded AI-buildout/semis blow-off into contracting liquidity breaks the most-extended momentum first; rotate to quality/low-vol/staples/healthcare + cash; gold/duration only help if it's a growth-scare (see caveats).
caveats: Duration (TLT) HELPS only if the unwind is a growth-scare (inflation_score < 0); if rates are still rising, duration adds risk, not safety.
Banks (XLF) are NOT a clean hedge — a liquidity event stresses credit; favor them only on a steepening-with-stable-credit read.
REITs (XLRE) are rate-sensitive — avoid while real yields are rising.
defensive_tilt.rate_sensitive_note: Growth-scare driver (growth weak / inflation falling): long duration (TLT) can HELP and banks' loan-loss risk dominates — duration as a hedge, banks still avoid.

state.rationale: Don't be fooled by the calm tape — the fragility (0.47, caution) is structural, not price-based. VIX 17.5 (52nd pctile, contango) and benign realized vol are exactly the complacency the engine flags (calm+fragility+credit_widen = watch). The real tell is the divergence: under a placid surface, three things are quietly deteriorating in sync. (1) Credit/USD axis is RISK-OFF (-0.20 tilt): HYG/TLT credit -1.5% on 5d, HY OAS +11bp on 21d — credit is leaking before equities. (2) Liquidity overlay is contracting in a Q1 Goldilocks quad — the worst combination, because positioning is maximally long into a thinning tape (SMH 98th pctile, +43% 60d; MTUM 99th). (3) Dealer gamma is the accelerant: SPY dealers SHORT gamma, spot 741.81 sits 0.28% BELOW the 743.86 flip with net GEX -1.6bn and a vol-hole in EXPANSION — meaning any down-impulse gets amplified, not dampened. So the picture is a narrow, crowded leadership (AI build-out / SMH) levitating on benign vol while credit and liquidity erode underneath and dealers have lost their stabilizing bid. That's a market that is fine until it isn't — fragile to a gap, not a grind. Crowding fragility reads low (0.18) only because momentum hasn't broken
